title: Larger default images, with some model changes
summary:
Images got a larger default size, text gained a practical-minded persona, and two community tools became easier to find.

Image requests without dimensions now default to 1024×1024, and Flux Schnell gained 1024×1024 generation through Cloudflare Workers AI. Flux and Turbo have lower maximum side lengths, while flux-realism, flux-anime, flux-3d, and any-dark were removed from the available image models. The text service also changed the backend used for llama requests.

The text service gained a Realistic assistant persona prompt focused on practical problem-solving, context-aware tone, actionable advice, and solutions that account for real-world constraints.

The homepage and README now point readers to a community Node.js package for image generation and LLM access, plus a dashboard for monitoring text and image servers.

highlights.title: Larger images by default
highlights.text: Image requests without dimensions now default to 1024×1024. Flux Schnell also gained 1024×1024 generation through Cloudflare Workers AI. [Try the playground](https://pollinations.ai/play).
